basic_info.description: Stunning fully detached custom-built home, perched atop Golden Gate Heights, offers breathtaking panoramic views and privacy. Home features a modern open concept style. Built in 2010, this architectural gem boasts soaring ceilings, beautiful hardwood floors, and high-end finishes throughout.    At the heart of the home is a chef's kitchen, thoughtfully designed for both style and functionality, seamlessly flowing into an expansive open living and dining area. A striking full fireplace wall serves as a focal point, while glass railings enhance the sense of openness and light.    The primary suite is a true sanctuary, featuring ocean views, private sunroom, a spacious walk-in closet, and a luxurious marble bathroom. Two additional bedrooms, along with a dedicated office, provide flexibility for modern living.    Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor enjoyment, the home features expansive decks and beautifully leveled yards, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The lot is large enough to potentially accommodate a stand alone ADU or additional garage. A two car garage adds convenience to this meticulously crafted residence, where every detail has been carefully curated to offer comfort, sophistication, and an extraordinary living experience.
